summary.en: A group can speak with a singular verb.

body.en:
From season 1, episode 1.

In season 1's opening exchange, *On est au Westin* refers to the people waiting together at the hotel. Conversational *on* often stands for a group including the speaker.

The verb stays in the third-person singular: *on est*, *on a*, *on va*. Do not attach a *nous* verb ending to *on*. The people involved can still be plural; the grammar of the subject chooses the verb form.

*on* can also refer to people in general, rather than to a particular “we”. Listen to the situation before deciding who is included. In this phone call the setting makes the group reading clear.

Replay the hotel line and find the subject and verb as one small unit. Recognising *on est* quickly leaves you more attention for the place name and the new information that follows.
